d:
Chhath mahaparv sirph bihar ka mahaparv nahin, balki bihar ki kala aur sanskritik virasat ka bhi hissa raha hai. lok aastha ke is mahan parv ko aaj antarrashtriy pahchan mil chuki hai. videshon men bhi log chhath mana rahe hain. lekin 'patna kalam' shaili ne do sadiyon pahle hi chhath ki sanskritik pahchan ko chitron men darj kar ise duniya bhar men pahchan dilane ka kam kiya tha.
